none: PAS NLM-14B8CB: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably Sol standing issue of 310-319, Reece period 15; two thirds or more of flan is lost. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [--]ONSTANTI[---]. Reverse description: probably Sol standing left holding globe. F in right field. Reverse inscription: [SOLI INVIC]TO COM[ITI]. Diameter (in excess of): 16mm, Weight: 0.93gms
